payload.statement: At the 11:43:25 UTC snapshot the issue remained open. Homebrew macOS 14 bottle failure and a proposed CI-image change were already public; #32372 was open but not merged.

source_record.title: macOS 14 CI dependency installation
source_record.freeze_context: At the 11:43:25 UTC snapshot the issue remained open. Homebrew macOS 14 bottle failure and a proposed CI-image change were already public; #32372 was open but not merged.

evidence_timeline.statement: A contributor narrowed a new macOS 26 interactive-framework crash to framework load order while the CI-image PR was being tested.
PR #32376 opened to load AppKit before CoreText, a blocker encountered while testing the builder-image change.
Contributor review approved #32372 conditional on #32376 landing.
Contributor clarified macOS 10.14 and macOS 14 are different releases, limiting an overly broad reading of usage statistics.
The separate macOS framework-load PR #32376 merged before the CI-image PR.
PR #32372 changed macOS CI builder images and explicitly marked the issue fixed; merged to main.
Issue closed one second after PR merge.
Maintainer said they were debating a 3.11 backport as CI was failing again, with a possible new LLVM problem.
Contributor supported backporting the CI change without treating it as a user-platform support drop.
Contributor described Homebrew on macOS 14 and earlier as unreliable under its Tier 3 policy.

phenomenon.assessment: macOS 14 CI package installation became unreliable; later CI failures persisted in a possible separate LLVM path.

cause.assessment: Homebrew support and bottle availability are the maintained explanation of the original failure; later LLVM failure not established as same cause.

ownership.assessment: CI image choice is Matplotlib’s; upstream Homebrew package support is outside its repository.

severity.assessment: Active CI breakage; no evidence that installed Matplotlib stopped supporting macOS 14.

fix_trajectory.assessment: Main-branch CI builder update merged and issue closed; backport was being debated, no 3.11 release/backport verified.

linked_prs.relationship: Separate blocker on macOS 26 encountered by #32372, not the original macOS 14 Homebrew issue

release_and_backport.note: Latest checked Matplotlib GitHub release v3.11.2 was September 11; backport discussion September 25–26.

unresolved: Whether the CI change was backported to v3.11.x

frozen_report_adjudication.miss_or_noise: Homebrew was explicit in the issue body, so this is extraction of pre-existing evidence, not an independently discovered cause. Five Python-version facts from a background compatibility table add noise; the subsequent LLVM failure/backport remains separate and unresolved.
